newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Intellect sells EFTPOS to NZ's Progressive.
newsitem.headline: Intellect sells EFTPOS to NZ's Progressive.

text.p: Software developer Intellect Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had sold some of its electronic payment terminals (EFTPOS) terminals to New Zealand retailer Progressive Enterprises Ltd for an undisclosed amount.
Intellect said it would team with NCR Corp to supply the terminals to all stores within the Progressive group including Countdown and Foodtown supermarkets.

The EFTPOS (electronic funds transfer point of sale) terminals can be upgraded to accept smart cards ensuring the supermarkets are prepared for the introduction of smart cards expected in New Zealand in 1998, Intellect said.

Intellect said it was the market leader for integrated EFTPOS terminals in New Zealand and Australia, having about 35,000 terminals installed between both countries, which represent around 70 percent of the integrated EFTPOS market.
Progressive is controlled by Perth-based grocery retailer Foodland Associated Ltd.
At 12.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) Intellect shares were steady at A$1.04.
